Transient environmental and hardware warnings occurred overnight that self-cleared quickly without causing service degradation.

The site experienced 29 minor and warning alarms between 2026-09-13 03:18 and 2026-09-13 04:16, all of which self-cleared within 10 minutes. KPIs such as availability, drop rate, and RRC success remained completely normal throughout.

- S-SUD-003 raised 29 low-severity self-clearing alarms including TEMP_HIGH, RECTIFIER_FAULT, FAN_FAILURE, VSWR_HIGH, and DOOR_OPEN between 03:18 and 04:16. [T3, ALM-000238, ALM-000239, ALM-000242, ALM-000243, ALM-000245]

## Inferences

- The site is not in trouble; the alarms were purely transient and had zero impact on service availability or KPIs. [T3, T4]
